congVote.result: So the amendment was agreed to.
congVote.dailyDigestSummary: The House passed H.R. 3196, making appropriations for foreign operations, export financing, and related programs for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2000 by yea and nay vote of 316 yeas to 100 nays, Roll No. 572.<P/>Agreed to the Young of Florida amendment that provides $1.825 billion to fully fund the President's request for the Wye River Accord and increases funding for other programs by $799.1 million by yea and nay vote of 351 yeas to 58 nays, Roll No. 571.<P/>Earlier agreed to H. Res. 362, the rule that provided for consideration of the bill.
